title: zenbu.language-data-manifest.v1
description: One language-data release: every file it contains, the CDN sources it names, its IDs, and the conformance suites it was checked against (issue 463). Written by language-data/pipeline/package.py. Cross-field rules JSON Schema can't express (unique names, depends_on naming a file or source in the release) are checked by `package.py validate`.

release.description: The release ID, YYYY.MM.N: the year and month it was cut, then a counter from 1 within that month.

git_commit.description: The commit the release was packaged from.

workflow_run.description: The GitHub Actions run that packaged it, or null outside Actions.

previous_release.description: The release this one follows, or null for the first.

previous_manifest_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the previous release's manifest.json bytes, or null for the first.

sources.description: Archives a client downloads from the CDN itself, which the release names but doesn't contain: today the Wikipedia and Jiten frequency-pack sources.

files.description: Every file in the release, stored at files/<sha256>/<name>.

ids.description: The dictionary's JMdict entry IDs (ent_seq), from the release's zenbu.language-reference file.

ent_seq_digest.description: How ent_seq_sha256 is computed: SHA-256 over every ent_seq in ascending numeric order, each written in decimal ASCII and followed by a line feed.

conformance.description: The conformance suites the release was checked against: every pin in them that names a file in the release matched its SHA-256.

core_sha256.description: The shared core's hash. Null until the core exists (step 6 of the plan on issue 463).

allOf.description: A first release has neither a previous release nor its manifest; a later one has both.

name.description: A file's name in the release: one or two path segments, such as Kuromoji/base.dat.gz.

depends_on.description: The files or sources in this release whose SHA-256 this file pins, by name.

artifact_schema.description: The file's format and version, or null when nothing declares one.

schema_source.description: Where artifact_schema comes from: `file`, the file's own metadata (a SQLite `metadata` row or a JSON `schema` key); `plan`, named in language-data/release-inputs.json because the file declares none; `undeclared`, nothing (artifact_schema is null).

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the file's bytes as committed, before any transport compression. For a Git LFS file, its LFS oid.

row_counts.description: SQLite files only: the row count of every ordinary table (not virtual tables, whose shadow tables are counted instead), by table name.
